name: dcf_valuation
description: Build a two-stage DCF valuation. Projects 11 line items per period to derive FCF, discounts back to intrinsic equity per share. Returns a forecast_id for later decomposition. Default: 10yr model, 3yr stage 1, 7yr stage 2, 10% WACC, 2.5% terminal growth.

revision_of.description: Parent forecast ID for same-symbol revision.

revenue_growth.description: Revenue growth override. Range -0.50–1.00. Calibrated from history if omitted.

da_to_revenue.description: D&A as % of revenue override. Range 0.00–0.20.

capex_to_revenue.description: Capex as % of revenue override. Range 0.00–0.30.

nwc_to_revenue.description: Net working capital as % of revenue override. Range -0.20–0.50.
